title: BoundedInputCertificateWire v1.0
description: Wire format for bounded-input Collatz trajectory certificates emitted by the Q5 PR #3 Python producer and verified by the Lean parser. Schema is immutable. Mirrors the Lean BoundedInputCertificateWire inductive (PR #62 v5): N + rawWitnesses + FiniteOrbitClaim (empty | singleton n | bounded K).

schemaVersion.description: Schema version. Immutable. The Lean parser rejects any value other than "1.0".

claim.description: FiniteOrbitClaim: the claim each witness's terminal value must satisfy.

oneOf.description: Empty claim (no orbit states). Terminal check always fails.
Singleton claim (terminal value must equal n).

K.description: Bounded claim (terminal value must be <= K).

oneOf.description: Bounded claim (terminal value must be <= K).

N.description: Bound on input domain. Witness at list index i corresponds to canonical input i+1. There must be exactly N witnesses (enforced by the decoder).

rawWitnesses.description: Per-input trajectory evidence. rawWitnesses[i] carries canonical input i+1.

leafId.description: Leaf identifier. ASCII-printable only (0x20-0x7E; no escape sequences). Mirrors Lean `parseAsciiString` + producer `_validate_ascii_identifier`.

leafProperty.description: Leaf property label. ASCII-printable only (0x20-0x7E; no escape sequences). Mirrors Lean `parseAsciiString` + producer `_validate_ascii_identifier`.

trajectory.description: Trajectory [start, acceleratedStep(start), ..., terminal]. Each consecutive pair must be an acceleratedStep transition. The terminal value must satisfy claim.Holds.
